answer: AI agents counter Sybil attacks using cryptographic proof of space. To participate, each node must bind pre-plotted tables to non-volatile storage accessed by its OS kernel. Whether surveying an arid mesa or mapping a coastal dune, an attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of dedicating physical drive sectors per identity. A major limitation is that adversaries with high-speed memory can compute proofs just in time, circumventing long-term capacity requirements.
